entries.title: Hebrews 10:1
segments: For the Law which has a shadow of good things to come, not the very image of the things, [appearing] year by year with the same sacrifices, which they offer continually, they are never able to perfect those drawing near.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:2
segments: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? Because the worshipers, when they had been once for all purged, would have had no more conscience of sin.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:3
segments: But in those [sacrifices there is] a remembrance again of sins every year.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:4
segments: For [it is] not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:5
segments: Therefore when He comes into the world, He says, "Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but You have prepared a body for Me.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:6
segments: In burnt offerings and [sacrifices] for sin You have had no pleasure.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:7
segments: Then I said, Lo, I come ([in the] volume of the Book it is written of Me) to do Your will, O God."

entries.title: Hebrews 10:8
segments: Above, when He said, "Sacrifice and offering, and burnt offerings and [offering] for sin You did not desire, neither did You have pleasure in them" (which are offered by the Law),

entries.title: Hebrews 10:9
segments: then He said, "Lo, I come to do Your will, O God." He takes away the first so that He may establish the second.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:10
segments: By this will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:11
segments: And indeed every priest stands daily ministering and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:12
segments: But this Man, after He had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down [on the] right of God,

entries.title: Hebrews 10:13
segments: from then on expecting until His enemies are made His footstool.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:14
segments: For by one offering He has perfected forever those who are sanctified.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:15
segments: The Holy Spirit also is a witness to us; for after He had said before,

entries.title: Hebrews 10:16
segments: "This [is] the covenant that I will make with them after those days, says the Lord; I will put My laws into their hearts, and in their minds I will write them,"

entries.title: Hebrews 10:17
segments: also [He ads], "their sins and their iniquities I will remember no more."

entries.title: Hebrews 10:18
segments: Now where remission of these [is, there is] no more offering for sin.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:19
segments: Therefore, my brothers, having boldness to enter into the [Holy of] Holies by the blood of Jesus,

entries.title: Hebrews 10:20
segments: by a new and living way which He has consecrated for us through the veil, that is to say, His flesh;

entries.title: Hebrews 10:21
segments: and [having] a High Priest over the house of God,

entries.title: Hebrews 10:22
segments: let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and [our] bodies having been washed with pure water.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:23
segments: Let us hold fast the profession of [our] faith without wavering (for He is faithful who promised),

entries.title: Hebrews 10:24
segments: and let us consider one another to provoke to love and to good works,

entries.title: Hebrews 10:25
segments: not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some [is], but exhorting [one another], and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:26
segments: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more sacrifice for sins,

entries.title: Hebrews 10:27
segments: but a certain fearful looking for judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:28
segments: He who despised Moses' law died without mercy on [the word of] two or three witnesses.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:29
segments: Of how much worse punishment, do you suppose, will be thought worthy [to receive] punishment, the [one] who has trampled the Son of God, and who has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

entries.title: Hebrews 10:30
segments: For we know Him who has said, "Vengeance [belongs] to Me, I will repay, says [the] Lord." And again, "The Lord shall judge His people."

entries.title: Hebrews 10:31
segments: [It is] a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:32
segments: But call to memory the former days, in which (after you were illuminated) you endured a great fight of afflictions,

entries.title: Hebrews 10:33
segments: indeed being exposed both by reproaches and afflictions, and while you became companions of those who were so used.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:34
segments: For you both sympathized with my bonds and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that you have in Heaven a better and an enduring substance.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:35
segments: Therefore do not cast away your confidence, which has great [recompense of] reward.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:36
segments: For you have need of patience, so that after you have done the will of God you might receive the promise.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:37
segments: For "yet a little while, and He who shall come will come and will not delay."

entries.title: Hebrews 10:38
segments: Now, "the Just shall live by faith. But if he draws back, My soul shall have no pleasure in him."

entries.title: Hebrews 10:39
segments: But we are not of withdrawal to destruction, but of those who believe to [the] saving of [the] soul.
